earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Symbotic reported revenue of $778 million, up 26% year-over-year, net income of $55 million, and adjusted EBITDA 1 of $114 million for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026.
In comparison, Symbotic posted revenue of $618 million, a net loss of $9 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $49 million in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2025.
For the full fiscal year 2026, Symbotic reported revenue of $2.8 billion, up 25% year-over-year, net income of $133 million, and adjusted EBITDA 1 of $354 million.

quotes.text: We executed on our commitments across-the-board.
quotes.by: Rick Cohen, Symbotic Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

quotes.text: Year-over-year revenue growth accelerated in the fiscal fourth quarter, and we delivered our first full year of GAAP profitability.
quotes.by: Izzy Martins, Symbotic Chief Financial Officer

outlook: For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Symbotic expects revenue of $805 million to $825 million and adjusted EBITDA 2 of $110 million to $120 million.
